angle: Distribution and workflow integration beat yet another note-taker feature list.
sourceTitle: Calendly throws its hat into meeting note-taker circus
linkedinPost:
Another AI note-taker? Distribution is the feature.

TechCrunch reports Calendly is adding an AI meeting note-taker and a scheduling assistant, Callie. The feature list looks familiar — summaries, action items, follow-ups. The difference is where it lives: in the same tool that already owns your meeting flow.

Here’s the pattern I see in enterprises:

- Teams are drowning in point tools with 20% adoption and 0% workflow change.
- The tools that win are embedded where work already happens and auto-sync to CRM, ticketing, and project systems without another tab or habit.
- Admin controls, data lineage, and audit trails matter more to buyers than slightly better summaries.

 #CustomerExperience #AIAdoption #EnterpriseAI
xPost: In meeting AI, distribution > features. Buy “least orchestration,” not “best notes.” Judge vendors by % of meetings with actions auto-synced to your system of record. #AIAdoption #EnterpriseAI
